summary_md: **Sant | AI creator ([@AprilBoySantanu](https://x.com/AprilBoySantanu/status/2116753360388861959))** shares *WebAnything* by Xie et al. ([arXiv 2610.37786](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37786)), a fully automated framework that reconstructs reusable, resettable web environments from real URLs for training and evaluating web agents.
